description: React component for a user search modal with email and user ID search, role selection, and API integration.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Fetches user data based on search text and field, updates options.

methods.name: debouncedSearch
methods.description: Debounced version of fetchUsers to limit API calls.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, triggers debounced fetch.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles user selection, updates form fields.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form and options, triggers onCancel.
